elements.element: Vendor has a duty to defend covered claims.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “HDI shall defend” against the covered claims.

elements.element: Vendor has a duty to indemnify against covered claims and resulting losses.
elements.evidence: HDI must “indemnify” against claims and all resulting damages, costs, expenses, and reasonable attorneys’ fees.

elements.element: Customer is a beneficiary of Vendor’s defense and indemnity.
elements.evidence: The defense and indemnity expressly run in favor of “the Company.”

elements.element: Customer’s affiliates are beneficiaries of Vendor’s defense and indemnity.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly protects “the Company and its affiliates.”

elements.element: Vendor’s defense and indemnity apply to third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The operative language applies to “any third-party claim.”

elements.element: Covered claims include allegations that Vendor’s services or deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Coverage includes an allegation that “the Site, the Services or any deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right.”

elements.element: Covered claims include claims arising from Vendor’s breach of applicable law.
elements.evidence: Item (2) expressly covers “HDI’s breach of applicable law.”

elements.element: Covered claims include data breaches caused by Vendor.
elements.evidence: Item (3) covers unauthorized access to or disclosure of Content, Confidential Information, or user data “caused by HDI.”

elements.element: Covered claims include claims arising from Vendor’s gross negligence.
elements.evidence: Item (4) expressly covers “HDI’s gross negligence.”

elements.element: Covered claims include claims arising from Vendor’s willful misconduct.
elements.evidence: Item (4) expressly covers HDI’s “willful misconduct.”

elements.element: The indemnification procedure requires prompt notice of a claim.
elements.evidence: The Company must give HDI “prompt written notice of the claim.”

elements.element: Vendor controls the defense of covered claims.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “HDI shall have control of the defense.”

elements.element: Customer must provide reasonable cooperation in the defense.
elements.evidence: The Company must “provide reasonable cooperation.”

elements.element: Any Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer’s breach of law.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause imposes no indemnity obligation on the Company, so there is demonstrably no Customer indemnity extending beyond the permitted categories.

elements.element: Vendor has an IP indemnification obligation.
elements.evidence: HDI expressly agrees to indemnify for covered intellectual-property claims.

elements.element: Customer is protected by the Vendor IP indemnity.
elements.evidence: The IP indemnity runs in favor of “the Company.”

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity applies to third-party claims.
elements.evidence: The indemnity expressly applies to “any third-party claim.”

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity covers allegations that the services or deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
elements.evidence: Item (1) covers allegations that the Services or deliverables provided by HDI infringe or misappropriate any intellectual-property right.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes infringement resulting from Customer modifications.
elements.evidence: No exclusion for modifications made by the Company or its representatives appears.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes infringement resulting from combinations with items not provided or approved by Vendor.
elements.evidence: No combination exclusion appears.

elements.element: The Vendor IP indemnity excludes infringement resulting from compliance with Customer specifications.
elements.evidence: No Customer-specifications exclusion appears.

elements.element: Vendor must procure the right for Customer to continue using affected services or deliverables.
elements.evidence: No procure-right remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must modify affected services or deliverables so they become non-infringing.
elements.evidence: No modification remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must replace affected services or deliverables with non-infringing substitutes.
elements.evidence: No replacement remedy is included.

elements.element: Vendor must provide a refund if the other IP remedies are unavailable or unsuccessful.
elements.evidence: No refund remedy or associated trigger is included.

elements.element: Vendor’s indemnity liability is subject to a super-cap of three times annual fees.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no liability cap or incorporation of a cap equal to three times annual fees.

result.reason: The added operative language satisfies every preferred requirement: HDI defends and indemnifies the Company and its affiliates against third-party claims across all four required risk categories, subject to notice, defense control, and cooperation procedures. The absence of any Company indemnity means the preferred limitation on such indemnity is not exceeded. The fallback is independently unsatisfied because all specified IP exclusions, all four remedies, and the 3× annual-fees super-cap are omitted. The insertion leaves the original Globix provision unchanged and adds no unrelated commercial obligation.
